title: not exactly as advertised
text: The ones they are showing for Oct, Nov and Dec 2021 are not the ones i recieved. those are kinda cool. I got some goofy ones. Its about a 50/50 mix of shirts that are neat. If you are not a star wars super fan you wouldnt catch half of the metaphors on the merch. probably gonna cancel but i have gotten about 15 shirts, for $25 a month it isnt terrible.
